claude.rationale: The slice states RAI's product lines and operating processes carry forward intact within the surviving corporation with no divestiture contemplated ("the combined company will continue to operate the businesses of RAI"), so T4 and T5 moved together — gap_45 = 0. RAI's officers continue as officers of the surviving corporation and the workforce continues intact, so the processes (T5) transferred alongside the organization/people (T6) — gap_56 = 0. Only the board/governance layer (T1) changes hands as BAT's designees replace RAI's pre-merger board, coded as replace; a 42%-owned affiliate becomes a 100% subsidiary with the legal entity, model, product, process, and people transferring whole (1-1).

There is no documented structural mismatch between product and process (gap_45 = 0) or process and organization (gap_56 = 0) at closing.
